# Halcyon vendor support and escalation matrix

**Owner:** Halcyon IT Service Desk (manager: Ruth Abernathy) · **Reviewed with:** HIPAA Security Officer · **Updated:** October 15, 2026

This matrix lists the outside vendors that support live Halcyon systems and services, the support hours they have committed to, and how fast they must respond. Response times are contractual first responses from a qualified engineer, not resolution times.

## Always start with the Service Desk

Open a ticket with the Halcyon IT Service Desk (extension 4357, or the Service Desk tile on the intranet) for every problem. The Service Desk contacts the vendor, tracks the vendor's response against this matrix, and for any P1 also pages the owning team's system steward (stewards are listed in the clinical systems change control policy). Clinic staff should not call vendors directly unless the Service Desk asks them to.

## Priority definitions

- **P1:** system down or unusable at one or more clinics, or any problem that creates a patient-safety risk (for example, results not arriving).
- **P2:** a major function is degraded but a workaround exists.
- **P3:** minor problems, single-user issues and questions.

## Matrix

| Vendor | System or service | Owning team | Support hours | P1 response | P2 response | P3 response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Meridian Clinical Systems | Meridian EHR | CI | 24/7 | 15 minutes | 2 hours | Next business day |
| ClearPath Software | ClearPath PM | RCM | 24/7 for P1; otherwise 07:00–19:00 Eastern, Mon–Fri | 30 minutes | 4 hours | 2 business days |
| Coriander Media | Video SDK and hosted media servers | VC | 24/7 | 20 minutes | 3 hours | Next business day |
| Larkspur Telehealth | Current telehealth video platform | VC | 07:00–21:00 Eastern, 7 days | 1 hour | 8 hours | 3 business days |
| Quillon Ambient | AI scribe (pilot) | CI | 06:00–22:00 Eastern, Mon–Sat | 2 hours | Next business day | 5 business days |
| Bayline Reference Laboratories | HL7 results feed into Switchyard | INT | 24/7 interface desk | 30 minutes | 2 hours | Next business day |
| Polyglen Interpreting | Interpreter operations desk | Clinical Operations | 24/7 | 10 minutes | 1 hour | 2 business days |
| RotaLeaf | HR and leave system | People team | 08:00–18:00 Eastern, Mon–Fri | 4 hours | Next business day | 3 business days |

## Notes

- **Meridian upgrades:** for any scheduled Meridian EHR upgrade, Meridian Clinical Systems staffs a live bridge line with its own engineers for the whole cutover window, in addition to the 24/7 support above.
- **Larkspur** support continues through the month-to-month extension and ends when the extension ends.
- **Quillon** problems outside support hours: clinicians stop using the scribe and document manually; there is no out-of-hours P1 line.
- **Polyglen**'s P1 covers an interpreter not connecting at all; slow connections within target are tracked in the quarterly language access report instead.
- **Built in-house systems** (Switchyard, Pillbox, the Halcyon app, the Juniper application layer and SafeReport) have no outside vendor. The Service Desk pages the owning team directly, using the same P1–P3 priorities.
- Vendors that do not yet support a live Halcyon system are not listed. Their support terms are agreed when the contract is signed.

## Escalating a missed response

If a vendor misses its P1 response time, the Service Desk escalates to the vendor's account manager and tells the owning team's steward. Two missed P1 responses in a quarter are reported to the HIPAA Security Officer and recorded in the vendor's annual review.
